runtime_freeze: Record exact runner image, kernel/configuration, selected ovpn module, libraries and binaries before samples. Prefer the runner kernel's available official ovpn module; build the pinned official backport only when absent. Never combine samples from different runtime identities.
scope: A dedicated disposable Linux VM with two real network namespaces. No container privilege escape and no modification of an existing production host.

p2p_fair_dispatch.policy: Context-local alternation only when SOCKET_READ and TUN_READ are simultaneously ready; SOCKET_WRITE and TUN_WRITE remain higher priority; DCO_READ dispatch is unchanged.
p2p_fair_dispatch.scope: Applied identically to the official C-user, HIA-user and C-DCO application builds. The unmodified upstream archive remains separately frozen and is never overwritten.
